## Appearance

Diana Barry is a very pretty little girl with rosy cheeks. She has dark features, including black eyes and glossy, jet-black tresses of hair.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010)_

## Personality

Diana Barry is a pretty, vivacious girl who is known for her good, kind, and sweet nature. In addition to her pleasant temperament, she is smart and particularly fond of reading, often spent poring over books.

## History

Diana Barry was named at birth by a boarding schoolmaster. She met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) in the Barrys' garden, where the two quickly formed a deep bond, swore eternal friendship, and built a playhouse called [Idlewild](../codex/places.md#idlewild). Their play was temporarily disrupted when her mother forbade them from seeing each other, but Diana maintained a secret connection with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) through written notes. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) saved the life of Diana's younger sister, [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), who was dangerously ill with croup, Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) lifted the ban and restored their friendship. Diana continued to share in Anne's milestones, hosting a party where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) broke her ankle, bringing her a Christmas gift from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), and celebrating their school concert together. Although Diana did not join the advanced class preparing for the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination, she remained Anne's devoted confidante, bringing her the pass list that revealed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) had tied for first place on the Island and accompanying her to a triumphant charity concert performance at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 CHAPTER XII. ## Quotes

> "I’m awfully glad you’ve come to live at Green Gables. It will be jolly to have somebody to play with. There isn’t any other girl who lives near enough to play with, and I’ve no sisters big enough."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)

> “Yes,” said Diana, tossing her head, “but I’m sure he doesn’t like Julia Bell so very much. I’ve heard him say he studied the multiplication table by her freckles.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P19](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0019)

> “Those Pye girls are cheats all round,” said Diana indignantly, as they climbed the fence of the main road. “Gertie Pye actually went and put her milk bottle in my place in the brook yesterday. Did you ever? I don’t speak to her now.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)

> “I don’t believe he’ll find the doctor at Carmody,” sobbed Diana. “I know that Dr. Blair went to town and I guess Dr. Spencer would go too. Young Mary Joe never saw anybody with croup and Mrs. Lynde is away. Oh, Anne!”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P24](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0024)

> "I guess we must have made as much as ten dollars. Mind you, Mr. Allan is going to send an account of it to the Charlottetown papers."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P49](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0049)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

Diana and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) became fast friends immediately upon meeting in the Barrys' garden, where they swore eternal friendship and created a playhouse named [Idlewild](../codex/places.md#idlewild). Their close bond faced a major challenge when Diana's mother temporarily forbade them from playing together, though the two secretly exchanged notes until [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) saved Diana's sister from croup and earned Mrs. Barry's forgiveness. Their friendship is deep and dramatic, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) even weeping over the future prospect of Diana one day marrying and leaving her.

- Friend of — bosom friend and schoolmate  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P35](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0035), +25 more</sub>

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--jane-andrews.md)

Jane is one of Diana's schoolmates and peers in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Along with their mutual friend [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), they attend school together, socialize at gatherings like Diana's party, and participate in shared school events. However, a slight rift in their shared school group emerges when Jane joins the advanced Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) preparation class while Diana does not.

- Comrade of — traveling together to a concert in a buggy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>

### [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--josephine-barry.md)

[Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) is Diana's aunt. Diana lives with her immediate family in the household that Josephine is related to.
